semantics.original_intent: A typed JSON object field carried through Fact storage/contract; no committed evidence assigns a final domain-specific authority owner.
semantics.current_schema_semantics: Top-level {} is valid. If namespaces are present, each key must be lower snake_case and map to a non-empty object; no extra properties are allowed.
semantics.current_business_semantics: Core Fact behavior does not require non-empty domain_metadata; {} is accepted by current tests, persistence defaults, projection, and canonical factory. Final domain-specific meaning and grounding ownership remain unresolved.

downstream_consumer_audit.evidence: Defaults {} and includes the value in canonical payload construction; source/material/review gates provide authority.
domain_metadata is part of the hashed canonical payload, so a value change changes identity; it does not grant authority.
Grounding checks cover subject, entity, status, scopes, quantities, and validity; no domain_metadata source quote policy exists.
Approval/currentness use lifecycle, lineage, validity, source and material authority predicates.
